description: This source file defines an Android activity named CrossfadeActivity that demonstrates cross-fading animations between two overlapping views: a loading spinner and content view. It includes methods for toggling the visibility of these views with smooth animations, manages animation durations, and handles menu interactions for navigation and toggling content loading status.

classes.name: CrossfadeActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating cross-fading between two overlapping views with toggle controls.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, retrieves views, and caches animation duration.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including navigation and toggling content load state.

methods.name: showContentOrLoadingIndicator
methods.description: Performs cross-fade animation between loading indicator and content views based on load state.
